units.title: Choose a zero-sum half of symmetric nonzero integers
units.statement: The nonzero integers from -n through n admit an n-element subset summing to zero exactly when n is at least 2. For even n, take opposite pairs. For odd n, take -2, -1, 3 and enough opposite pairs with magnitudes at least 4.
steps: For even n select n/2 opposite pairs
For odd n select the zero-sum triple and (n-3)/2 opposite pairs
